register.labelZh: PULL 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: pull ahead 可以表示某人取得領先;pull something back 則可以表示球隊追近比分。；pull away、pull over 和 pull up 能幫助你描述車輛駛離、在路旁停下或到達後停下。；你可以 pull for 某人、與其他人 pull together,或幫助某人 pull through 一段困難時期。；PULL 片語動詞可以描述拉動窗簾、帶上門、從口袋取出物件、拆開機器和拔除植物。；pull your socks up 可以叫某人改善表現;pull somebody down 則表示某事令人疲倦或情緒低落。
register.summaryEn: Pull ahead shows someone moving into the lead, while pull something back can describe a team reducing the other side's lead. Pull away, pull over and pull up help you describe a vehicle leaving, stopping beside the road or arriving and stopping. You can pull for someone, pull together as a team or help someone pull through a difficult time. PULL expressions can describe moving curtains, closing doors, taking things from pockets, taking machines apart and removing plants. Pull your socks up tells someone to improve, while pull somebody down describes something making a person tired or unhappy.
